{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

jobs:
  compatibility:
    name: "Compat ${{ matrix.os }}/${{ matrix.toolchain }}/${{ matrix.fdb_feature_version }}"

    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: ["ubuntu-latest", "macos-15", "macos-15-intel"]
        toolchain: ["1.85.1", "stable"]
        fdb_feature_version: ["fdb-7_4", "fdb-7_3", "fdb-7_1", "fdb-7_0", "fdb-6_3", "fdb-6_2", "fdb-6_1"]

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: 0
      RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
      # Select the matrix toolchain instead of the rust-toolchain.toml MSRV pin.
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.0

      - name: Setup FoundationDB
        uses: foundationdb-rs/foundationdb-actions-install@v2.3.0
        with:
          version: "7.4.3"

      - name: Check FDB library location
        run: |
          echo "=== Searching for libfdb_c ==="
          find /usr -name "libfdb*" 2>/dev/null || true
          find /opt -name "libfdb*" 2>/dev/null || true
          ls -la /usr/local/lib/ 2>/dev/null | grep fdb || echo "No fdb in /usr/local/lib"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --verbose -p foundationdb --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fdb_feature_version }}

      - name: Test
        # Examples needs to have uuid enabled
        run: cargo test --verbose -p foundationdb --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fdb_feature_version }},uuid


  test:
    name: "Test foundationDB with ${{ matrix.toolchain }}"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        toolchain: ["1.85.1", "stable", "beta", "nightly"]

    runs-on: "ubuntu-latest"

    env:
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.0

      - name: Install FoundationDB
        uses: foundationdb-rs/foundationdb-actions-install@v2.3.0
        with:
          version: "7.4.3"

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: "${{ matrix.toolchain }}"
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Run all tests of foundationdb
        run: cargo test -p foundationdb --features num-bigint,embedded-fdb-include,fdb-7_4
      - name: Run all tests of foundationdb with trace feature enabled
        run: cargo test -p foundationdb --features num-bigint,embedded-fdb-include,fdb-7_4,trace
      - name: Run all tests of foundationdb-tuple
        run: cargo test -p foundationdb-tuple --all-features
      - name: Run all tests of foundationdb-macros
        run: cargo test -p foundationdb-macros
      - name: Run all tests of foundationdb-simulation-tracing
        run: cargo test -p foundationdb-simulation-tracing --no-default-features --features embedded-fdb-include,fdb-7_4

  lint:
    name: Rustfmt / Clippy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.0

      - name: Install FoundationDB
        uses: foundationdb-rs/foundationdb-actions-install@v2.3.0
        with:
          version: "7.4.3"

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Fmt
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy-all

  audit:
    name: Cargo audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # rustsec/audit-check builds cargo-audit, which needs a current rustc; the
    # checked-in rust-toolchain.toml would otherwise force it onto the MSRV.
    env:
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: stable

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.0

      - name: Install FoundationDB
        uses: foundationdb-rs/foundationdb-actions-install@v2.3.0
        with:
          version: "7.1.37"
      - uses: rustsec/audit-check@v2.0.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Rust CI with repeated cargo dependency downloads across many matrix jobs (compatibility, test, lint) and no existing dependency cache. Evidence P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200) shows measured CI workflow savings of ~20.4% elapsed time from adding a dependency download cache, with preconditions met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable and Cargo.lock exists as a stable cache input. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git, keyed on runner.os and hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock'), preserves all build/test steps and required checks while avoiding caching unchecked build outputs. No contraindications apply: no equivalent cache exists and cached crate sources are content-addressed, not mutable/untrusted content.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}

          find /opt -name "libfdb*" 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}

      - name: Cache cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Test
        # Examples needs to have uuid enabled
        run: cargo test --verbose -p foundationdb --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fdb_feature_version }},uuid

    strategy:

        toolchain: ["1.85.1", "stable", "beta", "nightly"]

    runs-on: "ubuntu-latest"

    env:
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.0

      - name: Install FoundationDB
        uses: foundationdb-rs/foundationdb-actions-install@v2.3.0
        with:
          version: "7.4.3"

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:

          components: rustfmt, clippy

            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Run all tests of foundationdb with trace feature enabled
        run: cargo test -p foundationdb --features num-bigint,embedded-fdb-include,fdb-7_4,trace
      - name: Run all tests of foundationdb-tuple
        run: cargo test -p foundationdb-tuple --all-features
      - name: Run all tests of foundationdb-macros
        run: cargo test -p foundationdb-macros
      - name: Run all tests of foundationdb-simulation-tracing
        run: cargo test -p foundationdb-simulation-tracing --no-default-features --features embedded-fdb-include,fdb-7_4

      - name: Checkout repository

            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Fmt
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Clippy

        with:
          version: "7.1.37"
      - uses: rustsec/audit-check@v2.0.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
